validate_task_spec.task_title: Task 3: Ask for a missing ZIP
validate_task_spec.goal: When a lead's ZIP code is missing, the conversation asks for it.
acceptance_criteria: When the lead's ZIP field is empty, the first outbound message starts with the code-written question "What is your ZIP code?" before any model-written text.
The question is sent at most once per conversation.
validate_task_spec.context: The bot is an LLM agent; the model writes replies from a prompt and a facts block.
boundary_rules: Code checks structured data only. It never inspects reply or user words: no regex, phrase or keyword matching over them. Exception: STOP and HELP are matched in code, as carrier rules require.
The LLM writes every reply. The only code-written text is verbatim legal text.
